content.comment_body: Hello, I'm trying to execute an example from the [document] (reference: [document]), specifically the one on page 95. While there are no errors in the browser when displaying the example page, I encounter a 'Permission Problem' when the JavaScript function tries to modify a flag in the PLC memory (see attached HTML file). The PLC is on the local network with IP 192.168.1.3, and I'm attempting to change the M flag at this address. Within the [product_name] Project, this operation works; however, it does not work on the page I created based on the documentation example. When I click the JavaScript function in Microsoft Edge, the issue appears. Any guidance would be appreciated.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is unable to perform a JavaScript operation—outlined in the [document]—to change a PLC memory flag, consistently encountering a 'Permission Problem' in a custom web page, though the same function is successful in the [product_name] project environment. This points to unresolved permission or browser security context issues that are not covered by the official documentation, creating difficulties for developers aiming to use web integration features.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that JavaScript code examples provided in the [document] will reliably enable changes to PLC flags when used in custom web pages outside the official [product_name] project environment.
